summary: Practise discovery, relationship mapping and reliable follow-up in five days. Explore consultative selling training for customer-facing sales roles.
lede: Consultative selling training helps account executives, relationship managers and business developers turn customer conversations into clear priorities and agreed follow-up. It develops active listening and SPIN-based discovery, stakeholder and customer-journey mapping, and relationship plans informed by customer feedback and CRM follow-through.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who develop or maintain customer relationships through regular sales conversations, service interactions or account follow-up.
prerequisites: No previous consultative selling course is required. Familiarity with customer-facing conversations or account follow-up will help you apply the exercises to your work.
